title: Build and publish releases from GitHub Actions for Linux, Windows and macOS
notes:
There is no GitHub release yet. Build and publish the app from GitHub Actions. Agreed with the user (2026-11-06): no signing for now; three platforms; the first release is cut later, after this card and the what's-new card are merged.

- New workflow .github/workflows/release.yml, triggered by workflow_dispatch with an input bump: patch | minor | major (first release will be minor, v2.42.0).
- Job 1 (ubuntu): bump package.json version by the input (workflow-rule-3: the version moves only on a release), update CHANGELOG.md with a new section (merged PRs since the last v* tag: number, title, link; grouped as GitHub's generated notes group them), commit to main, tag vX.Y.Z, push, create a draft release with GitHub's generated release notes plus the CHANGELOG section.
- Job 2, matrix on the tag: ubuntu-latest (linux x64: .deb, .rpm, .zip), windows-latest (Squirrel Setup.exe and its RELEASES/nupkg), macos-14 (macOS arm64: .zip and .dmg). pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, pnpm run make, then `gh release upload vX.Y.Z <files>`; no new dependency (no Forge publisher). Electron's binary and pnpm store cached.
- Job 3: when every matrix leg uploaded, publish the draft. A failed leg leaves the release a draft and says which leg.
- The release body lists one download link per platform, written from the uploaded asset names.
- Unsigned: README and the release body say so, with the one-time step per OS (macOS right-click Open; Windows SmartScreen More info, Run anyway).
- Check the workflow on a fork or with a pre-release tag (v2.42.0-rc.1) before the real one; put that run's link in the PR. docs/workflow (README, decisions, history) updated.
